title: A Sentimental Journey Through France and Italy
sourceTitle: A Sentimental Journey Through France and Italy
author: Laurence Sterne
description: "A Sentimental Journey Through France and Italy" by Laurence Sterne is a novel published in 1768.
longDescription: It follows the Reverend Mr. Yorick, a character from Sterne's earlier work, on a picaresque journey through France told from a sentimental perspective.

authorInfo.bio: Laurence Sterne was an Anglo-Irish novelist and Anglican cleric. He is best known for his comic novels The Life and Opinions of Tristram Shandy, Gentleman (1759–1767) and A Sentimental Journey Through France and Italy (1768).
works: The life and opinions of Tristram Shandy, gentleman
